pages.title: Strand User Guide
pages.description: Learn how to use Strand, the fast, keyboard-first Git client for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.description: Download and install the Strand Git client on Windows, macOS, or Linux, then open your first repository.

pages.title: Workbench: Files & Terminals
pages.description: Use Strand as a Git client with an integrated file browser, lightweight editor, previews, and repository terminals.

pages.title: Customize the Workbench
pages.description: Arrange live Strand surfaces per workspace, or keep the default full-size Work surface.

pages.title: Repositories & Workspaces
pages.description: Manage multiple Git repositories, tabs, recent projects, and cross-repository workspaces in Strand.

pages.title: Repositories over SSH
pages.description: Connect through system OpenSSH to inspect remote repository status, history, diffs and file snapshots.

pages.title: Reviewing Agent Changes
pages.description: Review AI coding-agent changes with whole-file diffs, baselines, notes, and reusable feedback in Strand.

pages.title: Pull Requests
pages.description: Browse and review GitHub and Azure DevOps pull requests from the Strand desktop Git client.

pages.title: Worktrees
pages.description: Use Strand's Git worktree GUI to isolate agent tasks, compare attempts, review changes, and merge the winner.

pages.title: Everyday Git
pages.description: Stage files and lines, commit, branch, merge, rebase, resolve conflicts, and synchronize repositories visually.

pages.title: Commits & History
pages.description: Explore your Git commit graph, search history, inspect diffs, rebase commits, use reflog, and blame files in Strand.

pages.title: Keyboard & Command Palette
pages.description: Drive the Strand Git client from the keyboard with configurable shortcuts, focused navigation, and a command palette.

pages.title: Settings
pages.description: Configure Strand themes, diffs, Git identity, shortcuts, integrations, AI providers, updates, and privacy.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.description: Read how the local-first Strand Git client handles repositories, credentials, AI features, updates, and website data.

pages.title: Content Guidelines
pages.description: Read the content, reporting, and acceptable-use guidelines for Strand's Git hosting integrations and AI-assisted features.
